config.trigger: The simultaneous Wilson grid found no familywise signal, but Wilson intervals are approximate. This follow-up uses exact binomial intervals for Monte Carlo coverage rates.
config.monte_carlo_interval_method: Clopper-Pearson exact binomial interval for the repeated-simulation target interval coverage proportion
config.multiplicity: Bonferroni across five fixed effect sizes. Each marginal exact interval has coverage at least 99%; the union bound gives simultaneous familywise coverage at least 95% under independent simulation repetitions.
config.target_estimator: Unchanged household difference-in-means with two-sided Welch 95% target intervals.
config.dgp: Unchanged Bernoulli household return DGP from backend/app/analysis/workbench.py.

decision_rule.any_exact_simultaneous_interval_excludes: Evidence of an off-nominal target-interval coverage point in this specified synthetic DGP; preserve the estimator and investigate a separate method study.
decision_rule.all_exact_simultaneous_intervals_include: No familywise signal detected; this is not proof of calibration.

prohibited_changes: Do not reuse baseline or prior follow-up seeds.
Do not change the DGP, sample size, effect grid, target estimator, target interval, or primary effect after observing this study.
Do not describe these exact Monte Carlo intervals as making the target Welch interval itself exact.

results.scope: Target inference only, using the same household return DGP. Null rejection is false-positive rate; non-null rejection is two-sided power. Wilson intervals quantify Monte Carlo uncertainty. Candidate-surrogacy certification is not implied.

interpretation: No familywise signal detected; this is not proof of calibration.
coverage_guarantee_scope: Bonferroni familywise lower bound applies to the five Monte Carlo coverage proportions under independent repetitions; it does not make the target Welch intervals exact.
review_status: Self-review only; no independent peer review has occurred.
